The '''66th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary film|documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2013, were presented on January 25, 2014, at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=DGA: Alfonso Cuaron Wins Top Prize for 'Gravity'|url=https://variety.com/2014/film/news/live-from-the-dga-awards-1201070830/|access-date=January 19, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 25, 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=DGA Awards: The Winners|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/dga-awards-winners-674067|access-date=January 19, 2018|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=January 25, 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Alfonso Cuarón wins DGA Feature Film Award for "Gravity." Other winners of 2013 DGA Awards announced. |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2014/140125-DGA-Awards-Winners.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=August 9, 2018 |date=January 25, 2014}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Jane Lynch]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Jane Lynch to Host 66th Annual DGA Awards|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2013/121813-Jane-Lynch-to-Host-66th-Annual-DGA-Awards.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 19, 2018|date=December 18, 2013}}</ref> The nominees for the feature film category were announced on January 7, 2014,<ref>{{cite web|title=No Shockers Among DGA Awards Film Nominees: Cuaron, Greengrass, McQueen, Russell, Scorsese|url=https://deadline.com/2014/01/directors-guild-awards-film-nominations-full-list-659827/|last=Hammond|first=Pete|website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]|date=January 7, 2014|access-date=January 7, 2014}}</ref> the nominations for the television and commercial categories were announced on January 9, 2014,<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Awards TV Nominations Unveiled|url=https://deadline.com/2014/01/dga-awards-tv-nominations-unveiled-661138/|website=Deadline Hollywood|access-date=January 19, 2018|date=January 9, 2014}}</ref> and the nominees for documentary directing were announced on January 13, 2014.<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=Directors Guild Taps Five Documentary Nominees|url=https://variety.com/2014/film/news/directors-guild-taps-five-documentary-nominees-1201052629/|access-date=January 19, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 13, 2014}}</ref>
